name: Crown of the Earth
summary: In Shadowglen, you set out with moonwell water for Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar. The journey carries you from secluded training into the wider work of protecting Teldrassil.

sections.title: Leaving the Glade
sections.body: After tasting the enchanted water of Shadowglen's moonwell, you meet Tenaron Stormgrip at the crown of Aldrassil. He seals the gathered water in a larger vessel and sends you beyond the sheltered glade. The road runs south toward Dolanaar, through woods where danger has grown harder to predict.

sections.title: The Road to Dolanaar
sections.body: Dolanaar is the first major village beyond Shadowglen, along the cobblestone paths through central Teldrassil. Its own moonwell lies at the heart of the village. Corithras Moonrage, an elder who oversees preservation across the boughs, waits there. The vessel you bring places you in the wider effort to protect the World Tree.

faq.q: What am I carrying to Dolanaar?
faq.answer: You carry the Partially Filled Vessel, holding sanctified water from Shadowglen's moonwell. Tenaron Stormgrip gathered your offering in it for Corithras Moonrage to use in ritual work across Teldrassil.
Corithras Moonrage is a night elf elder beside the moonwell in Dolanaar. He directs those who arrive in rites and investigations meant to sustain the World Tree.

faq.q: Why does Tenaron send me away from Shadowglen?
faq.answer: Shadowglen gives you basic training, while Teldrassil's troubles reach across the boughs. After you prove yourself against local threats and honor the moonwells, Tenaron sends you to Dolanaar, where broader work awaits.

faq.q: Where is the road to Dolanaar?
faq.answer: Follow the cobblestone path south from Aldrassil and through Shadowglen's gates. Keep to the road as it bends south and west, and it will bring you to Dolanaar.

faq.q: Why does Tenaron warn about dangerous beasts?
faq.answer: Tenaron says dangerous beasts have roamed the forests of late. Wildlife has grown aggressive even within Teldrassil's sacred boughs, so leaving the paved trail puts you at risk.

aliases: what next after crown of the earth
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage takes the vessel and sends you to fill phials at other moonwells throughout Teldrassil. The work continues across the tree.

angles.text: As a young Kaldorei, leaving Shadowglen is a rite of passage as you set out to serve your people.
As a druid, carrying the sanctified waters connects you to the effort to nurture and balance Teldrassil's growing ecosystem.
As a priest, carrying moonwell water consecrated by Elune's grace reflects your duty to tend to your community's spiritual health.
